summary.text: Virgil Peck is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 15 (Montgomery County), serving in the Senate since 2021 after House service from 2005 to 2016. The legislature lists Peck as chair of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and of the General Government Subcommittee of Ways and Means, and vice chair of the Assessment and Taxation Committee; the listed occupation is insurance agent.
